profile.headline: Lead Senior Software Engineer @ CarMax
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the airlines/aviation industry. Skilled in Databases, .NET Framework, HTML, C#, and Visual Studio. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's of Science focused in Biology and Chemistry from Sam Houston State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a system to streamline image uploads and utilized AI to pre-analyze documents, reducing manual verification efforts.
• Integrated bi-directional SMS communication via Twilio, boosting customer conversion by providing real-time vehicle document verification updates.
• Implemented asynchronous, event-driven services using Azure Service Bus and Azure Functions to handle non-critical operations like customer emails and SMS communications.
• Manage Azure deployments with Bicep and ARM Templates, ensuring consistent resource definitions and control over environment variables.
• Integrated internal enterprise service APIs to facilitate interactions with systems managing vehicle purchases and appointment scheduling.
• Transitioned from ARM to Bicep templates, enhancing flexibility and reusability in deployment architectures.
• Developed API services and Azure Functions to support remote verification and scheduling for customer vehicle purchases.
• Designed scalable systems that supported the initial test markets and nationwide rollout of product.
• Implemented Azure DevOps to manage CI/CD pipelines, streamlining build and deployment processes.
• Analyzed user flows, customer feedback, and interviews to identify and address product flow improvements.
• Managed source code with GitHub Enterprise, enabling cross-team collaboration and seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.
• Utilized Cosmos No-SQL database for application specific data storage and optimize resource allocation.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Visual Studio · Programming · Databases · Software Development · SQL · Git · Azure Functions · Microsoft SQL Server · GitHub · Azure Cosmos DB · ASP.NET Core · .NET · Microsoft Azure · Twilio · C# · Azure · Azure DevOps Services · Bicep (Domain-Specific Language) · YAML · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · GraphQL · Azure resource management template · ASP.NET

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed event based windows microservices with Microsoft Orleans technology for the United app’s contextually aware customer specific travel cards. 
•	Using asynchronous development patterns, created microservices to update the customer’s app data based on flight and reservation events and triggered the device to sync using push notifications.
•	Worked on backend API services supporting the customer facing iOS and Android United Airlines mobile applications.
•	Set up Couchbase NoSql database and Sync Gateway to manage syncing of data directly to mobile device. 
•	Onboarded new developers to the project, enforced coding standards, and performed code reviews before deployment.
•	Worked with Business Analysts to organize and assign tasks to backend developers, and followed up with team members to make sure development was on schedule for releases.
•	Developed new services and optimized the data flow for a redesign of the United Airlines mobile app.
•	Worked with integrating NoSQL database, Couchbase, with United Airlines customer facing app.
•	Design data structure and process for compact and efficient data transfer for API calls.
•	Created architectural diagrams showing complex data structure and design for application.
•	Development technologies/languages include: C#, TFS, T-SQL, Couchbase, N1QL, Microsoft Orleans, AGILE/SCRUM, MS SQL Server, MS Visual Studio, Web API, and MVC.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on backend API services supporting the customer facing iOS and Android United Airlines mobile applications.
•	Refactored and optimized Rest API used by enterprise iOS application with 24,000 internal users.
•	Migrated codebase to truck based development structure and set up a 4-tier deployment environment for application.
•	Created architectural diagrams showing complex data structure and design for application.
•	Worked with Product Owners to identify needs and address them in a way that met the needs of the users while streamlining the backend logic.
•	Development technologies/languages include: C#, TFS, T-SQL, AGILE/SCRUM, MS SQL Server, MS Visual Studio, Web API, and MVC.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop and perform maintenance on web based project management system used globally by internal clients company-wide and external clients.
•	Rebuilding the company's core application focusing on modular role based UI using AngularJS.
•	Work with internal clients and development team to create streamlined UIs for departments based on responsibilities.
•	Migrated all data from preexisting data structure into new database after a previous rewrite of the main project management system.
•	Support internal clients globally to increase productivity and self-sufficiency.
•	Development technologies/languages include: SCRUM, AngularJS, JavaScript, jQuery, C#, MS SQL Server, MS Visual Studio, TFS, MVC 3, T-SQL, ASP.net, and VB.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
•	Served as business systems analyst for entire geochemical lab.
•	Developed and implemented analytical tools to increase productivity and efficiently of lab.
•	Project, Lab, and Inventory Database QC and Integrity Management using MS SQL Server.
•	Developed detailed lab and methodology documentation for training and to better understand their interaction with the current systems.
•	Engaged with general manager to understand business needs and developed.
•	Supported and resolved all technical issues for internal clients at location.

positions.title: Assistant in Data Management
positions.description:
•	Reduced processing and handling time of data by leveraging automated systems.
•	Self-initiated development of macros and formulas in Excel to handle repetitive tasks.
•	Re-mastered and quality controlled seismic data.
